summary: Remote agent runner: pairs with api.factiii.com to execute AI-agent commands on the installer's host
details: The package is a long-running daemon advertised as a remote agent runner that pairs with Factiii's cloud control plane at https://api.factiii.com over WebRTC/WebSocket (socket.io) and executes Claude/Codex AI agent sessions on the installer's machine via node:child_process / PTY. The remote control plane can therefore cause command execution on the host that runs the daemon. The daemon is user-invoked via the `factiii-runner start` CLI (no npm lifecycle hooks are declared), the pairing channel is authenticated with a JWT and OS keychain-encrypted secrets with an optional connection password, there is no local listener bound, and the destination host is the publisher's own first-party domain. State reads are confined to the package's own `~/.factiii-runner` directory; no installer-secret paths (`~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, `~/.npmrc`, browser or wallet stores, environment scraping) are accessed. The tarball also vendors prebuilt `frpc` (fatedier/frp) reverse-proxy client binaries (~15 MB each) for linux/darwin x amd64/arm64 under `vendor/`, which when used alongside the agent runner can tunnel local services out to the control plane. The remote-execution capability is the product's documented purpose and matches the behavior described in the package metadata and README.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
